Teach Skill (teach-skill)

Turn any folder into a persistent, interactive multimedia AI classroom for Google Antigravity.
Stateful multi-session tutoring • Vetted primary sources • Verified offline visuals & teaching captions • Interactive SVG animations • Auto-generated Podcast Audio Overview • Printable PDF E-Books

--- ## Why Teach Skill? Ordinary AI chat is great for quick answers, but terrible for *actually learning* a new language, framework, or complex topic: - Conversations scroll away and reset next session. - Explanations come from unverified parametric memory instead of primary docs. - Passive walls of text feel productive, yet nothing sticks a week later. **Teach Skill** brings the stateful `/teach` workflow (inspired by Claude Code's `/teach`) to **Google Antigravity** — and expands it into a full **offline-first multimedia learning studio**. Every session remembers where you left off, verifies what you retained, and builds a personal library of illustrated lessons, interactive animations, audio podcasts, cheat sheets, and printable PDF e-books that you own forever. --- ## Key Features - **Goal-First Onboarding (`MISSION.md`):** Interviews you on *why* you're learning, your current level, constraints, and preferred language before teaching a single concept. - **Flexible Source Control (`sources/` + `RESOURCES.md`):** Choose between **3 Source Modes** during onboarding: - **`auto`:** AI searches and vets official docs, museums, and canonical guides automatically. - **`user-only` (AI Search OFF):** Drop your own paywalled academic papers, PDFs, e-books, notes into `sources/` (or paste YouTube/website links) — lessons and slides are built strictly from *your* materials with exact citations. - **`hybrid`:** Combines your private `sources/` as primary ground truth with vetted web references. - **Verified Offline Visuals + Teaching Captions (`assets/`):** Downloads real Public Domain / Creative Commons images locally (no broken hotlinks) and enforces a mandatory **2-part caption** under every visual: *(1) what to notice & how it proves the concept* + *(2) creator, year, license, and source URL*. - **Interactive Concept Animations (SVG/CSS/JS):** Embeds lightweight, zero-dependency step-through animations directly inside lessons to visualize mechanisms, flows, and timelines. - **Auto-Generated Podcast Overview (NotebookLM-style):** Automatically writes a 2-host conversational summary and embeds an offline **Built-in Podcast Player** (Web Speech API with Play/Stop, speed control, and live-highlighted transcript) right inside the lesson — zero manual audio production required. - **Interactive 16:9 Slide Decks (`slides/*.html`):** Generates zero-dependency Reveal-style web presentations in **PowerDeck Geometric Blue Diamond** or **Clean Scientific Modern** themes — max 3–4 lines per slide, photorealistic AI studio visuals in 45° diamond frames, inline SVG workflow diagrams, keyboard navigation (`←`/`→`), Speaker Notes (`N`), Fullscreen (`F`), and 16:9 PDF export — verified via real screenshot Visual QA. - **Printable PDF E-Books (`ebook/*.html`) & Living Cheat Sheets (`reference/*.html`):** Compiles chapters into a Canva Editorial Magazine-style E-Book & Audiobook Reader (with `Aa` font slider, Dark Mode toggle, Waveform Audio Player, and 1-click **Print / Save as PDF**) alongside compact syntax/timeline reference sheets. - **Active Recall & Mastery Logs (`learning-records/*.md`):** Runs a quick retention check before unlocking the next lesson and records what you've mastered, misconceptions cleared, and your next Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD). - **Repo Safety Guard & Language-Adaptive:** Warns you before writing classroom files inside an active software repo, and adapts all files and audio to your language (Thai, English, etc.). --- ## Classroom Workspace Layout When you run `/teach` in a dedicated folder, it builds and maintains this clean offline structure: ```text my-learning-folder/ ├── MISSION.md # Your goal, background, constraints & success criteria ├── RESOURCES.md # Curated official docs, guides & verified visual credits ├── NOTES.md # Tutor scratchpad: your pace, style & sticking points ├── assets/ # Local verified Public Domain / CC images (offline-safe) ├── lessons/ │ ├── 01-foundations.html # Offline HTML lessons (visuals, SVG animation, podcast, quiz) │ └── 02-next-concept.html ├── podcast/ # Optional standalone podcast scripts or local audio ├── reference/ │ └── cheat-sheet.html # Compact syntax tables, timelines & glossary ├── ebook/ │ └── topic-ebook.html # Printable / Save-as-PDF compiled summary e-book └── learning-records/ └── 001-foundations.md # ADR-style mastery logs & next ZPD target ``` --- ## Included Offline HTML Templates Every generated lesson and cheat sheet uses [`skills/teach/references/html-templates.md`](skills/teach/references/html-templates.md) — **100% offline-ready** (zero CDN scripts, zero remote fonts) with automatic Light/Dark mode (`prefers-color-scheme`): 1. **Interactive Multimedia Lesson (`lessons/NN-.html`)** -
